product_wide_rationale: Resolution staleness partitions Product-wide concurrent-work authority, so no child Domain can decide which contract changes affect an operator's overlap judgment.
summary: Amends CD-0222 D6 so a contract revision makes an overlap resolution stale only when it changes affected Domains, law additions or modifications, Domain modifications, or Domain-relation modifications. Preserves the 2,513-row resolution population, the execution-start claim boundary from PR 1084, D7, the closed resolution kinds, operator approval, and CD-0036.
title: Contract-content staleness for overlap resolutions
